name: Marathon
purpose: Decide what training session a marathon runner should do today, from weeks to race, body signals and recent training. Send weeks, pain, sleep, streak, longrun, hard or feel, separated by spaces; it answers doctor, rest, easy, long, tempo or taper, and invalid request for anything else.
inputLabel: Request: weeks pain sleep streak longrun hard feel

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: MA-01: the app always answers doctor when pain is at least 7. MA-02: the app never answers tempo when pain is at least 4. MA-03: the app never answers long when pain is at least 4. MA-04: the app always answers rest when feel is sick and pain is below 7. MA-05: the app always answers rest when streak is at least 6 and pain is below 7. MA-06: the app never answers long when weeks is at most 2. MA-07: the app never answers tempo when weeks is at most 2. MA-08: the app never answers long when sleep is below 5.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  pain is at least 7 → doctor
  feel is sick → rest
  pain is at least 4 → rest
  streak is at least 6 → rest
  sleep is below 5 → easy
  feel is tired → easy
  weeks is at most 2 → taper
  longrun is at least 7 → long
  hard is at least 3 → tempo
  otherwise → easy
proposition.plain: Decide what training session a marathon runner should do today, from weeks to race, body signals and recent training.
